label: Bible Study
note: The commandment against killing — four words in the KJV, about as short as law gets.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Behold, I have graven thee upon the _____ of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
verse: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
note: Not a note on the fridge — your name engraved on God's own palms. He can't open His hand without seeing you.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But God prepared a _____ when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
verse: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
note: God prepared a gourd for Jonah's shade, then a worm to wither it — an object lesson about caring for the wrong things.

label: Deep Water
prompt: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my _____ come.
verse: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
note: Job asks the oldest question about death — and five chapters later answers it with 'I know that my redeemer liveth.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were _____ and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
verse: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
note: 'Unlearned and ignorant' — no rabbinic training, yet people could tell they'd been with Jesus.
